card.title: EXCLUSIVE: Deportees, Illegal Immigrants With Rap Sheets Caught Soliciting Sex With Young Girls
card.description: When five illegal immigrants arrived at a hotel in Homestead, Florida, on June 9, they thought they’d be greeted by underage girls they could sexually abuse. Instead, they were met by law enforcement...

tweets.text:
SCOOP: An illegal immigrant who was supposed to be deported nearly three decades ago allegedly raped a 16-year-old girl in New York as she was walking home, @DHSgov tells @realDailyWire 

59-year-old Aureliano Antonio Melendez Reyes, of El Salvador, allegedly approached the teen in Huntington, New York, on June 6 and asked for her phone number, which she refused to hand over. Reyes then allegedly forced her into an alley before sexually assaulting her.

The teen girl was able to break free from Reyes and managed to scale a tall fence while partially clothed before calling 911. The accused rapist continued to pursue the teenager while she was on the phone with authorities.

Police arrived at the scene, where they arrested the alleged predator.
